# Data Loading

```{r}
citation("curatedTCGAData")
```

```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
library(S4Vectors)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Query and download gene expression data for TCGA-SKCM
expression_query <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-SKCM",
                             data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                             data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                             workflow.type = "STAR - Counts")
GDCdownload(expression_query)
expression_data <- GDCprepare(expression_query)
```

```{r}
query2 <- GDCprepare(expression_query, directory = 'GDCdata', summarizedExperiment = T)
save(query2, file = 'SKCM.rda')
```

# Visualisation

```{r}
data <- load("/Users/jeslynbowman/Documents/Uni/2025, Year 3/Sem 5, 2025/DATA3888/Group Project/data3888_capstone/SKCM.rda")
```

```{r}
counts <- assay(query2)                # Gene expression counts
genes  <- rowData(query2)              # Gene info
samples <- colData(query2)             # Clinical/sample metadata
```


```{r}
# Define gene of interest
gene <- "ENSG00000000003.15"

# Extract the row for TSPAN6 (or any other gene you're interested in)
gene_row <- rowData(query2)$gene_id == gene
expr_gene <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")[gene_row, ]

# Check the expression for the gene (it should have 473 values for 473 samples)
head(expr_gene)

# Extract 'days_to_birth' and convert to years
days_to_birth <- colData(query2)$days_to_birth
years_to_birth <- -round(days_to_birth / 365.25)  # Convert to years and flip sign

# Create a data frame with Expression and Age (years_to_birth)
df <- data.frame(Expression = log2(expr_gene + 1), Age = years_to_birth)

# Remove rows with NA values (if any)
df <- na.omit(df)

# Plot the data
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = Expression)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(title = paste("Expression of", gene, "vs Age"),
       y = "log2(Expression + 1)", x = "Age") +
  theme_minimal()

```
